text: 全球“大块头”集中亮相进博会，外资巨头押注中国智能制造 在进博会技术装备展区中，工业自动化、人工智能、精密制造、半导体装备和未来能源成为高频关键词。
text_en: Global heavyweights gather at CIIE as foreign giants bet on China's smart manufacturing. At the CIIE technical equipment exhibition area, industrial automation, AI, precision manufacturing, semiconductor equipment and future energy became high-frequency keywords.
